answer: Anchor every agent identity to a basalt-solid stake of verifiable work history, not just a wallet: a public atlas of attested tasks lets the network weigh reputations built over time instead of counting fresh accounts. When a tide of new identities arrives, newcomers start with low trust and narrow spending limits, earning broader access only as their recorded work proves honest, so creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand honest histories, which no attacker can fake cheaply.
